name: Sudoku
description: Sudoku taught one solving technique at a time, from picture grids for five-year-olds to X-Wings. Full puzzles that need each technique, and timed drills to spot it fast.
author: Koda Math Lab
tagline: Every row, column and box, once.

features.name: Spoken voice
features.description: Reads the lesson prompt aloud. Turn off for a silent lesson.

features.name: Sound chimes
features.description: Plays a short sound when a number is placed, and when a puzzle is solved or a move is found.

features.name: Haptic vibration
features.description: Adds a small vibration when a puzzle is solved or a move is found.

settingsSchema.label: Speech rate
settingsSchema.help: How fast Koda reads the prompt aloud.
